# VivaClean

> VivaClean is a house cleaning company in Austin, Texas. VivaClean is a service-area business, so cleaners come to your home and there is no storefront to visit. Open 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM every day. Phone: (512) 661-7297. Email: support@getvivaclean.com.

Every clean follows an 85-point checklist, the cleaners are background checked, and the company is bonded and insured. Prices are flat rate and published, with the full price shown before you book.

## Services

- [All cleaning services](https://www.getvivaclean.com/services/): every service on one page
- [House cleaning](https://www.getvivaclean.com/house-cleaning-austin/): standard one-time and recurring home cleaning
- [Deep cleaning](https://www.getvivaclean.com/deep-cleaning-austin/): a full top to bottom clean
- [Move in and move out cleaning](https://www.getvivaclean.com/move-in-move-out-cleaning/): cleaning for empty homes at moving time
- [Airbnb cleaning](https://www.getvivaclean.com/airbnb-cleaning-austin/): turnover cleaning for short-term rentals
- [Apartment cleaning](https://www.getvivaclean.com/apartment-cleaning-austin/): cleaning for apartments and condos
- [Maid service](https://www.getvivaclean.com/maid-service-austin/): regular maid visits on a schedule
- [Housekeeping](https://www.getvivaclean.com/housekeeping-austin/): ongoing housekeeping help
- [Office cleaning](https://www.getvivaclean.com/office-cleaning/): cleaning for offices and workplaces
- [Post-construction cleaning](https://www.getvivaclean.com/post-construction-cleaning-austin/): cleanup after building or remodeling work

## Pricing

A standard clean is priced by a published formula: $129 plus $25 per bedroom plus $25 per bathroom plus $8 per 100 square feet. For example, a 2 bed, 2 bath, 1,200 square foot home is $325 as a standard clean. A deep clean is 1.5 times the standard price, and a move in or move out clean is 1.75 times. Recurring plans save from the second visit: 20% off weekly, 15% off every two weeks, 10% off monthly.

- [Pricing](https://www.getvivaclean.com/pricing/): full rates and worked examples
- [How much does house cleaning cost in Austin](https://www.getvivaclean.com/blog/how-much-does-house-cleaning-cost-austin/): a plain cost guide
